newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Matahari store damaged in Jakarta fire.
newsitem.headline: Matahari store damaged in Jakarta fire.

text.p: An outlet of Indonesian retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima in a central Jakarta shopping complex was badly damaged by fire on Monday, witnesses said.
Matahari officials were not immediately available for comment.
"The Matahari store appears to be badly damaged. The complex is still ablaze," one eyewitness told Reuters.
She said firemen were trying to extinguish the fire, which broke out at around 5.30 a.m. on Monday.
Witnesses said around 100 shops in the shopping complex in Pasar Baru were affected by the fire.
The cause of the fire and the cost of the damage were not immediately known.
A Matahari outlet was damaged by fire during riots in the west Java town of Tasikmalaya in late December.
